subject: keyboard-focus-order
text: - An element is focusable if it holds a sub-document, or if it is not inert (by presence on itself or an ancestor element, `Node::is_inert`), is no disabled form control and either has `tabindex >= 0` or, with no tabindex, is an `<a>`/`<area>` with `href` or a `button`, `input`, `select`, `textarea`, `frame`, `iframe` or `summary` (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:732-764) — `disabled` read by its presence on a form control alone (`ElementData::is_disabled`: `can_be_disabled()` and the attribute present), any value, bare, `"false"` or `"true"`, so a `<div disabled tabindex=0>` takes focus; the Tab walk (`focus_next_node` / `focus_prev_node`), autofocus (a disabled form control or an inert candidate skipped) and `DioxusDocument::unkeyed_actionable` read it (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:514-518; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:733; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:563-580; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:614-655) — the presence reading ratified by the founder (2026-10-13, «По наличию (Рекомендую)», confirmed on the wrap's answer card on 2026-10-14 «Подтвердить (Рекомендую)», each by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label), its narrowing to form controls and the `inert` read ratified by the founder (2026-10-18); a known limit stands: HTML's focus fixup is not built, so a node that holds focus when it becomes inert keeps it until focus moves (tests/blitz-tests/tests/inert_subtree.rs:68-93; tests/blitz-tests/tests/inert_subtree.rs:144-194), its fix owned by a `.andromeda/residuals.md` line (target: next)

subject: keyboard-focus-restoration
text: - A pointer click on a `button` (any type) or an `input` of type `submit`, `reset` or `button` focuses it through `generate_focus_events` / `set_focus_to`, then submits the form owner when it is a submit button, and ends the walk matched — since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness, in every document; before it a submit button submitted without breaking the walk and every other button fell through to the unmatched clear of focus, so an accepted click on one left no element focused (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-scrolling-box-bounds-and-hit/report.md); a disabled form control still stops the walk first, a disabled ancestor `div` not (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18), a click on a `select` focuses it through `generate_focus_events` / `set_focus_to`, clearing its typeahead and the document's text selection, a disabled select stopped by the walk's gate first so it neither focuses nor acts, while an option is not clicked (a driver `click` on one is refused `covered`) (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:857-870; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_select.rs:172-198; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_select.rs:235-256), and a click on any other element is unchanged — a CRUD row or the list still clears focus; on the stand a click focuses each stand button and Tab continues from it, and after an accepted driver `click` on `fx-before` it reads `focused` and is the tree's focus, in both layout modes (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:909-921; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:984-1001; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:575-602; the restated `stand_act_obstructed`) — ratified by the founder (2026-10-13, «Клик даёт фокус (Рекомендую)», each by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness/report.md

subject: visual-contrast
text:
- Since 2026-10-13-stand-contrast-harness the stand's controls carry a measured SC 1.4.3 reading. blitz-test-harness's `Harness::text_contrast` (read-only: no mutation, input, pump or settle) takes the text-bearing element — a text input itself, else the parent element of the first non-whitespace text node under the node —, its computed `color`, `font-size` and `font-weight`, and the background behind it: each ancestor's `background-color` composited source-over down to the first opaque layer, else the root-else-`body` canvas over opaque white; it reads `None` where an element on that walk has `opacity` below 1, a non-empty `filter` or a `background-image` layer. `contrast_ratio` is the WCAG 2.x ratio over the `color` crate's relative luminance (Chrome's `GetContrastRatio`, blitz-paint's helper restated, blitz-paint untouched), and `TextContrast::required_ratio` asks 3.0 of large text (at least 24 px, or 14 pt at weight 700 or more) and 4.5 of other text. The stand check `stand_contrast` records one row per `controls(task)` row over the four lean tasks at boot (800 × 600 · scale 1 · Light · DejaVu Sans · offline), identical in both layout modes — 18 rows.
 Since 2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions the stand's accent is one step darker, stand-wide, in every task CSS that declares it — rest `#3a5ce5`, hover `#2a4cd3`, active `#1f3fc1`, white on each 5.47 · 6.83 · 8.27; the operator's F5, a stand change and no engine change (design-system §Color Palette) — and the record reads pass 14 (`back-btn` ×4, `#333333` on `#f0f0f0`, 11.09; `flight-return` 9.33; `flight-start` 17.40; `crud-filter`, `crud-name` and `crud-surname`, `#000000` on `#ffffff`, 21.00; and the five accent controls `counter-increment`, `flight-one-way` — the active toggle at boot —, `flight-book`, `timer-reset` and `crud-create`, each `#ffffff` on `#3a5ce5` at 5.47), fail 0, exempt-inactive 3 (`flight-return-date`, `crud-update` and `crud-delete`, exactly the rows whose snapshot `enabled` is `Some(false)`), no-text 1 (`timer-duration`, the range input); until then the five accent controls read `#ffffff` on `#4a6cf7` at 4.39 against 4.5, failing. No text is large, so every threshold is 4.5; no measured colour differs from its declared value, and the painted pixel matches the measured background within 1 per channel on all 17 measured rows. Beside the record one shared reader classifies two more tables, its exempt class still exactly `enabled == Some(false)` from the snapshot and a `label[for=…]` row never exempt: `TEXT_ROWS`, 14 rows — the CRUD list rows and the text outside the controls — all pass, the lowest 9.74 (`label[for=timer-duration]`); and `STATE_ROWS`, 19 colour states reached by input — return-chosen 3, start-unparseable 2, booked 1, row-selected 3, hover 5, active 5 — pass 18 and exempt 1 (`flight-book` disabled, `#ffffff` on `#a0aec0`, 2.26), the lowest pass 5.11 (`flight-start` invalid, `#c53030` on `#fff5f5`).
 `text_contrast` reads the declared `:hover` background after `move_mouse_to` and the `:active` one after `mouse_down_at`, the same in both layout modes; a button with no `:active` rule keeps its hover background while pressed, so the active rows of CRUD's buttons and `back-btn` read the hover pair. Three tests assert the three tables in both layout modes, so SC 1.4.3 is met on every measured non-exempt stand row; the check runs in the workspace `test` leg, per package and in the `a11y` leg (§9) (packages/blitz-test-harness/src/contrast.rs:13-23; packages/blitz-test-harness/src/contrast.rs:25-41; packages/blitz-test-harness/src/contrast.rs:56-91; packages/blitz-test-harness/src/contrast.rs:121-147; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_contrast.rs:49-137; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_contrast.rs:481-512; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_contrast.rs:514-564; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_contrast.rs:168-187; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_contrast.rs:206-279; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_contrast.rs:299-417; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_contrast.rs:577-605; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_contrast.rs:607-635; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_contrast.rs:637-661 — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-13-stand-contrast-harness/report.md and its evidence/pairs.md, the re-colour, the two tables and the three tests at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions/report.md and its evidence/hover-active.md)

subject: visual-contrast
text: - Since 2026-10-19-visual-lint `Harness::text_contrast` has its first non-test caller: the `contrast` reading of escher-driver's visual lint (`Session::lint` in process and the `lint` verb on every carrier, recorded; packages/escher-driver/src/execute.rs:293-295) — a node with direct non-whitespace text or a text control, read through `text_contrast` and reported below `required_ratio()`, exempt exactly where the snapshot's `enabled` reads `Some(false)`, a `None` reading not measured — the exempt rule `stand_contrast` asserts, with no second formula or threshold; a `contrast` finding is written `id` · `defect` · `bounds` · `ratio` · `required`, ids, closed words and numbers only (packages/escher-driver/src/json.rs:280-308). The stand at boot reads no `contrast` finding on the four lean tasks in both layout modes, the nodes outside `stand_contrast`'s rows included; a planted low-contrast row reads 2.8490272 against 4.5, equal to `text_contrast`'s own reading; the `a11y` leg reads 43 tests over 6 targets, unmoved (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_lint.rs:173-293; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_lint.rs:394-416 — as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-19-visual-lint/report.md and its evidence/readings.md)

subject: visual-visibility
text: - Nodes with `display: none` or `visibility: hidden` or carrying `inert`, and their descendants, are excluded from the accessibility tree, and so from the snapshot — a select's option excepted from `display: none` (§4 Hidden content), so a select's options are its children in the tree and the snapshot; a hit answers nothing at an element carrying `inert`, before any other test, so a hit passes through it, and removing `inert` restores the tree and the hit (the `inert` read ratified by the founder (2026-10-18)) (packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:19-28; packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:254-274; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1437-1446; tests/blitz-tests/tests/inert_subtree.rs:95-194); a hit also skips a node dropped since the last resolve (architecture §Standard Contracts → Scrolling, selection, tree)
